## Current signals

- WebNR remains a local-first browser reader and may be described as an independent browser-based alternative for some Legado users and web-first reading workflows. It is unaffiliated with Legado and is not an official Legado web client. Arbitrary Legado source JSON is not yet a drop-in WebNR runtime; compatibility claims remain tied to tested capability levels and versioned fixtures.
- `https://www.webnovel.win/` is the sole canonical public identity for documentation, reader-facing articles, search indexing, canonical tags, sitemap, and RSS. `https://app.webnovel.win/` is the reader application runtime; `https://autoarchive.github.io/webNR/` is an attributable documentation build mirror only.
- Pull request #118 expands `Fanfiction Discovery Starter` to seven audited first-party discovery destinations: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub, Archive of Our Own (AO3), SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, and Sunset. The shipped capability remains static link-only: WebNR stores destination URLs plus WebNR-authored descriptions/labels and does not crawl, poll, proxy, mirror, download, or copy origin works, story metadata, covers, ratings, comments, bookmarks, accounts, or story text.
- AO3 is no longer in the generic deferred queue. Refreshed first-party evidence supports its Work Search discovery route, while official AO3 documentation separately establishes canonical-tag Atom feeds as a syndication surface and the official OTW-Archive repository states that there is currently no general API. AO3 canonical-tag Atom is therefore a richer machine-interface candidate, not a capability WebNR currently claims to synchronize.
- Fimfiction remains the strongest immediate official-API candidate. Its richer adapter should advance only after source-specific rate-limit/cadence, cache, stable identity, pagination, response bounds, timeout, update/deletion, provenance, attribution/account, and versioned-fixture behavior is implemented and tested.
- The 2026-08-26 source program screened five new adjacent archive families beyond the existing starter: SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, Sunset, Ad Astra, and CFAA. SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, and Sunset received complete bounded audits and shipped as link-only routes. Ad Astra's current primary site and CFAA presented Anubis anti-bot challenges in the operating environment; no bypass was attempted. Existing FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, and Scribble Hub routes were rechecked.
- Pull request #118 also publishes the substantial 2026-08-26 fanfiction / transformative-serial-fiction guide. It exceeds 5,000 Chinese main-text characters, cites 24 academic/research sources plus 27 first-party/platform/community sources, uses community threads only as qualitative examples, and introduces a `双轴查询 + 五层发现 + 三种时间语义` synthesis for explainable fanfiction discovery.
- The currently accepted maintained source set is: WebNR Originals, Aozora Bunko Starter, Standard Ebooks Starter, Project Madurai Starter, English Serial Platforms Starter, Project Gutenberg Starter, Global Grey Starter, Online Books Page Starter, Wolne Lektury Starter, Wikisource Starter, English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter, Chinese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Japanese Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Korean Web-Fiction Platforms Starter, Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter, and Fanfiction Discovery Starter. Rights/access behavior remains source-specific; several maintained catalogs are intentionally link-only at their current proven capability level.
- The deferred/source-audit queue still includes candidates such as Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, Baen Free Library, LitFic, Betakyte, Hungry's Hedgerow, Ream, Laterpress, Fanqie / 番茄小说, Changpei / 长佩文学, 潇湘书院, 红袖读书, SF轻小说 / 菠萝包轻小说, 刺猬猫, ハーメルン, Nolaノベル, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, pixiv novels, 카카오페이지 / KakaoPage, 조아라 / Joara, OneStory, Bookcube, MrBlue, Ascendant Reads, ProgFans, Royal Guard Publishing, The Legion Publishers, Twisting the Hellmouth, Ad Astra current-primary integration, and CFAA.
